title: Stakeholder alignment and RACI matrix builder
description: Maps stakeholders, decisions, responsibilities, dependencies, and unresolved ownership conflicts.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: stakeholder-alignment-raci
  title: Stakeholder alignment and RACI matrix builder
  description: Maps stakeholders, decisions, responsibilities, dependencies, and unresolved ownership conflicts.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Establish clear accountability and engagement for a program or initiative.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 3
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - sponsor-approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Initiative scope and stakeholder list
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - scope
          - deliverables
          - stakeholders
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: map
      kind: agent
      name: Map stakeholders and decisions
      role: Program analyst
      prompt: Identify decisions, deliverables, dependencies, stakeholder interests, and required participation levels.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - communication
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: raci
      kind: agent
      name: Build RACI matrix
      role: Operating model designer
      prompt: Assign one accountable party per activity where possible. Flag conflicts, gaps, and overloaded owners.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: resolve
      kind: loop
      name: Resolve ownership conflicts
      config:
        body:
          - map
          - raci
        exitCondition: raci.conflicts == 0
        maxIterations: 2
        onExhausted: warn
    - id: sponsor-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Sponsor approves RACI
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Stakeholder map, RACI, and engagement plan
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: map
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: map
      to: raci
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: raci
      to: resolve
      kind: control
      condition: failed
    - id: e4
      from: raci
      to: sponsor-approval
      kind: control
      condition: passed
    - id: e5
      from: resolve
      to: sponsor-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exhausted
    - id: e6
      from: sponsor-approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
    - id: resolve-exit
      from: resolve
      to: sponsor-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
